headline: Q2FY27 Update

highlights: Positives: • TEAM’s EBITDA margin of 1.0% was in line with our estimate. • The specialized staffing EBITDA margin was 7.0%, higher than our estimate of 6.6%. • Specialized staffing vertical’s revenue increased 15% yoy and was 1.4% ahead of estimates.

Negatives: • TEAM posted revenue growth of 2.3% yoy, 3.0% lower than our estimates. • EBITDA of Rs36.2 cr was lower than estimates. • Specialized staffing EBITDA came in at ~Rs13.3 cr, lower than our estimates of Rs14.2 cr.
(EBITDA: Earnings Before Interest, Tax, Depreciation and Amortization; HR: Human Resources, PE: Price-to-Earnings) ` ` ` The content of this document has been derived from KIE research report.
